Entry Winter Herds of the North Cattle, sheep, horses, and pigs were used as meat, leather, and labor, a difficult choice that had to be made before winter came. Lords can kill and preserve livestock in advance, and ordinary farmers are often reluctant to lose an ox that can plow the land; when winter reserves are insufficient, livestock die first, and people's hearts follow. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.

They may not necessarily understand ledgers, but they know the true weight of a bag of salt and a nail on the road.
